node.title: Pair-feasible E1 rows lie in the prime-field kernel scope
node.statement: At each of the six named clean predecessor anchors, pair feasibility first forces F_p(Q)=F_q. Writing q=p^d, the canonical quotient roots then give d=ord_N(p), where N is 256 or 512. Exact perfect-power interval checks exclude every possible d>1: the prize interval has no such perfect power, and the only four RowC square roots have the wrong parity or multiplicative order. Hence q=p and p=1 mod N on the live pair-feasible E1 branch. This validates the prime-field sparse-kernel interface but proves no collision allowance.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: closes the extension-degree scope gap left by ambient generation. The exact pointwise E1 collision target remains open.
